title: OpenAI Codex super app teaser and slash goal feature
summary: OpenAI posted a teaser hinting at a Codex super app that merges ChatGPT, Codex, browsing, voice agents, remote control and computer use into a unified desktop experience. A new slash goal feature was also surfaced, giving Codex an end-state target it iterates toward, with users reporting multi-day autonomous runs on arc-AGI-style tasks.

research.notes: Teaser plus internal-feature reporting; slash goal hidden under /experiment.
